localized.zh_cn: 来自神秘远征的修改：隐藏要素在完成对应认知研究前不可见；常规源质生产和随机原始要素选择排除隐藏要素。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Expedition hides special aspects until their recognition research is complete and excludes them from ordinary essentia production and random primal selection.

localized.zh_cn: 来自神秘远征的修改：解锁隐藏要素后需重新扫描目标；奖励逐要素记录，不会重复获得已扫描要素的点数。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Expedition requires rescanning after hidden-aspect recognition; rewards are tracked per aspect without repeating previously awarded points.

localized.zh_cn: 来自神秘远征的修改：自然节点若只含隐藏要素，会补入可见的风要素。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Expedition adds visible Aer to natural nodes that would otherwise contain only hidden aspects.

localized.zh_cn: 来自神秘远征的修改：常规源质生产不会产出隐藏要素；其获取遵守远征的独立机制。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Expedition excludes hidden aspects from ordinary essentia production; they follow Expedition’s separate acquisition rules.
